jobs.title: Snowflake Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Data is de motor van elke digitale transformatie. Werk je graag mee aan de meest innovatieve data oplossingen van de toekomst? Dan heeft Cegeka de uitdaging voor jou! We zijn binnen ons Data & AI team binnen Cegeka op zoek naar een Snowflake Data Engineer. Als expert op het gebied van Snowflake zal je een cruciale rol spelen binnen onze uitdagende Snowflake projecten. Wij hanteren hierbij steeds een “Public Cloud First” Strategie. Naast ons partnership met Snowflake zijn we ook Microsoft- en Databricks-partner. Heb je zin om ons team van specialisten te vervoegen? Solliciteer dan zeker en laat je talent en ervaring bijdragen aan onze missie!

In je rol als Snowflake Data Engineer werk je nauw samen met collega's aan data- en AI-projecten voor bedrijven in verschillende sectoren.
Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt robuuste, schaalbare ELT-pipelines met dbt (ook native via dbt Projects on Snowflake), georkestreerd met Apache Airflow of Snowflake Tasks, Streams en Dynamic Tables, met een sterke focus op automatisering en herbruikbaarheid.
Je ontsluit data uit bronsystemen met Snowpipe (Streaming) en Snowflake Openflow / Apache NiFi, en transformeert die volgens de business logica tot betrouwbare datamodellen op het centrale dataplatform. Datakwaliteit en robuustheid staan centraal.
Je bouwt mee aan open lakehouse-architecturen met Apache Iceberg tables en Iceberg-catalogs (Horizon Catalog, Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris).
Je ondersteunt domeinteams volgens data mesh-principes en ontsluit data products via secure data sharing en het Internal Marketplace.
Je bewaakt governance (RBAC, masking en row access policies, tagging) en performance en kosten (warehouse-sizing, resource monitors, query profiling).
Je automatiseert deployments via CI/CD en gebruikt CoCo (Cortex Code) om sneller en beter te ontwikkelen.
Je vertaalt functionele en technische requirements naar concrete dataoplossingen.
Cegeka is Snowflake-partner. Dit geeft je rechtstreeks toegang tot hun solution architects bij technische uitdagingen of specifieke vragen.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je hebt ruime ervaring als Data Engineer of in een hands-on datarol binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen.
Je werkt dagelijks met Snowflake en beheerst SQL en Python (Snowpark).
Je hebt hands-on ervaring met dbt en met orkestratie via Airflow of Snowflake Tasks en Dynamic Tables.
Je hebt ervaring met data-integratie via Snowpipe en Snowflake Openflow / Apache NiFi.
Je bent vertrouwd met Apache Iceberg tables en Iceberg-catalogs (Horizon Catalog, Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris, catalog integrations met bv. AWS Glue of Unity Catalog).
Je kent multi-cloud omgevingen (Azure, AWS) en integreert die met Snowflake (storage integrations, external volumes, private connectivity).
Je werkt met CI/CD: versiebeheer in Git, geautomatiseerde deployments met Snowflake CLI en/of Terraform, en testen in de pipeline.
Je bent vertrouwd met Snowflake CoCo (Cortex Code), de AI-codingagent van Snowflake.
Je kent Snowflake-governance en -kostenbeheer (RBAC, masking en row access policies, warehouse-sizing, resource monitors).
Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in datamodellering (Data Vault, Kimball) en past die schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar toe in productie.
Een bepaalde flexibiliteit naar verplaatsingen is vereist aangezien er regelmatig van bij de klant wordt gewerkt. Als je aanwezigheid bij de klant niet vereist is dan kan je in het Cegeka-kantoor dichtst bij je woonplaats werken (Antwerpen, Brussel, Gent, Hasselt of Leuven) in combinatie met thuiswerk.
Pluspunten: SnowPro Core / SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer.
Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels. Kennis van het Nederlands en Frans zijn een grote meerwaarde.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Je komt terecht bij een echte Top Employer.
Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud & Infrastructure Services en Network & Connectivity.
We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren.

You’re not alone. We strongly believe that data and the intelligent use of it hold a lot of potential for making an impact that matters to our clients, our people and society.

Join us in making this impact!

Your journey with us

The life of a Senior Data Engin eer is very diverse. From implementing, code reviewing, and debugging data pipelines to leading large teams in complex data migrations for our clients.

Your role and tasks can switch frequently depending on the project at hand, meaning that one day you might be building a data warehouse and the next you are assisting our cloud team with providing the right information for the ideal setup for a large data platform.

You will be the key link between Deloitte leadership, Client leadership, your own technical team and both the technical & business teams at the client.

Internally you will leverage your knowledge & experience to bring your fellow data engineers to the next level, while also build PoC’s accelerators that will help our clients in getting the most out of their data.

Key Responsibilities

Designing, implementing and maintaining Snowflake data platforms on Azure and/or AWS, integrated with the surrounding cloud services (storage, orchestration, identity, BI).
Connecting heterogeneous source systems — ERP, CRM, operational, financial and third-party data — into a governed central platform.
Translating business requirements into technical solutions, and challenging them where a simpler or more scalable design exists.
Data modelling: creating a conceptual model and translating it into a logical and physical one.
Building and optimizing ELT/ETL data flows (SQL, dbt, Snowpark, Python) and tuning warehouse cost and performance.
Implementing platform security on Snowflake: RBAC role hierarchies, authentication and SSO, masking and row access policies, data classification.
Enabling AI and GenAI use cases on the platform — Snowflake Cortex, vector search / RAG patterns, and the data foundations that make them work.
Contributing to client workshops, architecture design sessions and deliverables, with growing autonomy.
Supporting proposals and contributing to internal assets, accelerators and knowledge sharing.

Let's Talk About You

You have 2–3 years of hands-on experience in data engineering or data platform work;
You have solid hands-on Snowflake experience and hold a Snowflake certification, or are willing to obtain SnowPro Core within your first months with us;
You are strong in SQL and comfortable writing Python;

An advanced Snowflake certification (SnowPro Advanced: Architect or Data Engineer).

The key is knowing when to take advantage of the new technologies to drive product and service enhancements, improve financial performance, and accelerate speed to market.

When you harness the power of analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI), you can uncover hidden relationships from vast amounts of data. Implementing the right strategy and technology will balance speed, cost, and quality to deliver measurable business value.

Never stop growing!

jobs.title: Data Engineer - AI & Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus
is an international group of 3000 experts
across 30 countries
, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.
For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work - designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

Intelligent systems are only as dependable as the data beneath them. Reliable pipelines, trusted data products, governed access, and meaningful enterprise context allow analytics, applications, models, and agents to operate consistently in production.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates
.
Industrial discipline connects the two.

What You'll Architect

As a Data Engineer - AI & Data Platforms, you will design, build, and operate reliable data products and pipelines that support analytics, applications, and intelligent systems.

This is fundamentally a Data Engineering role, with an additional focus on preparing enterprise data for modern AI use cases. You will work across structured and unstructured information, transforming source data into trusted, reusable data products that can support analytics and operational applications as well as RAG, retrieval, evaluation, and agent-enabled systems.

Your Responsibilities

Design, build, test, and operate production data pipelines and data products, moving data reliably from enterprise source systems into reusable consumption layers.
Develop and maintain data models and transformation logic that preserve clear definitions, business context, and reliable use across analytical, operational, and AI workloads.
Implement data quality, lineage, metadata, and observability controls, ensuring critical data is trustworthy, understandable, and monitored in production.
Prepare structured and unstructured enterprise data for intelligent systems, including retrieval, grounding, RAG, semantic context, and evaluation datasets where required.
Engineer reliable ingestion and processing patterns across APIs, databases, files, documents, events, and other relevant enterprise sources.
Operate and improve data workloads in a major cloud/data ecosystem, balancing reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost.
Collaborate with AI Engineers and Software Engineers on stable data interfaces, without taking ownership of model behavior, agents, or the surrounding application.
Document and reuse data-engineering patterns, including data contracts, transformations, controls, dependencies, and operational knowledge that can strengthen future Keyrus engagements.

Who You Are

You are a hands-on Data Engineer who understands that moving data is not enough. Data must remain trusted, understandable, available, and usable once a system is operating in production.

You think from source to consumption and can determine what is required to turn fragmented enterprise data into reliable data products.

You combine strong engineering fundamentals with practical judgment. You understand that analytics, applications, RAG systems, evaluations, and agents may consume data differently, and you design the foundation accordingly without trying to own the intelligence or application layers yourself.

What You Bring

Must Have

Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and data products.
Strong SQL and data-modeling fundamentals, with the ability to design clear, maintainable transformation and consumption layers.
Practical engineering capability in Python or another language commonly used for production data engineering.
Deep practical expertise in at least one major cloud data ecosystem, with the ability to apply the same engineering principles across comparable technologies.
Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, lineage, or observability within production data workflows.
Understanding of production engineering concerns including reliability, scalability, security, access, maintainability, and performance.

Should Have

Experience preparing structured and unstructured data for AI or GenAI use cases.
Practical understanding of how RAG, retrieval, embeddings, semantic context, and evaluation datasets depend on enterprise data.
Experience working with distributed processing, orchestration, and modern data-transformation approaches.
Experience with batch ingestion and one or more additional patterns such as APIs, change data capture, event-driven processing, or streaming.
Working knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, version control, and repeatable deployment practices for data solutions.
Experience with vector or hybrid search infrastructure used for retrieval-based AI systems/ Feeding and maintaining RAG indexes
Rapid prototyping, from mockup to working proof of concept in days (Streamlit)
Experience collaborating with AI, software, analytics, architecture, or governance teams that consume or define requirements for the data products you build.

Could Have

Experience with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, ontologies, or enterprise knowledge architectures.
Experience building data foundations for agentic systems or complex GenAI applications.
Experience with real-time or high-volume streaming architectures.
Experience with ML data pipelines, feature stores, evaluation datasets, or MLOps integration
Dashboards when needed, BI restitution on top of the data products
Experience in regulated, high-security, or data-sovereignty-sensitive environments.
Consulting or professional-services experience.

Illustrative Technology Environments - Not All Required

Depending on the engagement, Keyrus data environments may include technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery, Redshift, Spark, dbt, Airflow, or comparable cloud-native data services and orchestration technologies.

The role does not require expertise across all of these platforms. Candidates should demonstrate strong depth in at least one relevant ecosystem and the engineering judgment to work across comparable environments.

What Makes You Successful

You think in terms of trusted data products, not pipelines as an end in themselves.
You combine strong engineering fundamentals with production discipline.
You identify data-quality and reliability risks before they become downstream AI or application failures.
You know when a requirement belongs to Data Engineering and when it should move to AI, Software, Architecture, or Governance.
You make pragmatic decisions about performance, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
You document what you build and turn successful data patterns into reusable knowledge across engagements.

Rewards - What We Offer At Keyrus

Growth

At Keyrus we have created an environment where people are supported, challenged and connected to the people around them.

Working on impactful Data & Digital projects you will develop a broad and versatile skill set and stay ahead in a fast-evolving, AI-driven landscape.

Our digital learning platform, with over 30,000 courses including in-house trainings developed by our experts, is a perfect way to stay on top of your game

A generous training budget is available to help foster a culture where learning, feedback and continuous improvement is the norm

You will have a dedicated coach, benefit from regular check-ins, learn via different communities and have clear alignment with your team and company goals

We want you to grow with confidence. We therefore place a strong emphasis on ownership, open feedback and continuous development.

When people feel trusted, connected and inspired, they do their best work!

Rewards

Mobility budget? Car with fuel or charging car? We offer both so you can choose!

On top of that we also have daily and monthly net allowances, eco vouchers, hospitalisation (DKV) insurance and group insurance, as well as a generous bonus scheme that you can use on our flexible reward plan.

What We Stand For

Collective Intelligence
— We combine expertise, functions, and geographies to solve complex client challenges.

Reliability
— We deliver complex work with rigor and build lasting client trust.

Pragmatism
— We prioritize concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

Entrepreneurial Spirit
— Curiosity, energy, and freedom enable initiative and sustained innovation.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process straightforward and respect candidates' time. The local process should normally include:

A conversation with the Talent team to discuss the candidate's background, expectations, and what Keyrus can offer.
A technical architecture conversation focused on recent production AI architecture, architecture decisions, system boundaries, non-functional requirements, and the candidate's primary technology ecosystem.
An architecture case or representative challenge to understand how the candidate evaluates trade-offs, defines a target architecture, and communicates decisions to engineering and client stakeholders, followed by a final conversation with the relevant technical or business leadership. The assessment should focus on architectural proficiency and decision-making rather than the number of technologies a candidate can list.

About Keyrus

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. As Architects of Intelligence
, we design the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, embedding intelligence into business processes so that it creates sustainable, measurable value. We operationalize intelligence
.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), we architect reliable:

Intelligence Foundations
Human in Command governance
Performance Steering

With 30+ years of expertise and 3000 experts across 30 countries, we build adaptive, resilient intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capability and performance compounds over time.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

Keyrus is listed on Euronext Growth Paris. (ALKEY - ISIN Code: FR0004029411 - Reuters: KEYR.PA - Bloomberg: ALKEY: FP).

For more information: www.keyrus.com

For over 30 years, Keyrus have been Architects of intelligent systems. We have combined engineering, business consulting, data architecture, and AI in real operational environments. We have done this whilst never forgetting a more human enterprise of allowing humans to design, supervise, and shape what only they can create.. Find out more on our services on keyrus.com.

jobs.description:
Lead Engineer – Vulcan Platform Team

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly capable and experienced Lead Engineer
to join the Vulcan Platform Team
. This role will provide technical leadership in the design, delivery and optimisation of platform and data engineering capabilities that underpin scalable, secure and reliable data products across the organisation.

The successful candidate will bring strong experience in cloud-native engineering
, with particular depth in AWS
and Databricks
or similar Data lakehouse technologies and will be comfortable leading engineers whilst remaining hands-on in architecture, design and delivery. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys shaping engineering standards, improving platform capabilities, and working closely with cross-functional teams to enable high-quality, governed and performant data solutions.

The Lead Engineer will play a key role in advancing the Vulcan platform, ensuring it meets current and future business needs through robust engineering practices, automation, observability, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

Lead, coach and mentor engineers within the Vulcan Platform Team, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration and continuous learning.
Provide hands-on technical leadership across platform design, software engineering practices and delivery execution.
Set and uphold engineering standards, including code quality, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and operational support.
Support technical decision-making, architecture reviews and prioritisation of platform improvements in line with strategic objectives.
Work closely with product, architecture, security and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable engineering solutions.

Platform Engineering & Architecture

Design, build and maintain scalable, resilient and secure platform capabilities usingAWSandDatabricks.
Lead the development of reusable platform services, patterns and frameworks that accelerate delivery for data and engineering teams.
Drive the design and implementation of modern data and platform architectures, including lakehouse-oriented and event-driven patterns where appropriate.
Ensure platform solutions are designed for reliability, performance, maintainability and cost-efficiency.
Champion automation and infrastructure-as-code approaches to improve consistency, deployment speed and operational control.

Data & Pipeline Enablement

Oversee the design and implementation of robust data pipelines, ingestion frameworks and transformation workflows.
Support the development of scalable data processing solutions leveragingDatabricks,Spark, and AWS-native services.
Ensure high standards of data quality, observability, lineage and operational supportability across platform components.
Partner with data consumers, product teams and domain teams to enable effective use of shared platform capabilities.
Contribute to the evolution of platform services that support governed, self-service and reusable data product delivery.

Cloud, Security & Operational Excellence

Utilise AWS services such asS3, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, RDS, IAM, CloudWatchand related tooling to build and optimise platform services.
Ensure security, compliance and governance requirements are embedded into engineering solutions by design.
Improve monitoring, alerting, logging and incident response processes to strengthen platform reliability and service performance.
Support cost management and optimisation across cloud infrastructure and workloads.
Work with enterprise and security teams to ensure alignment with Marsh technology standards and risk controls.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Stay current with developments across AWS, Databricks and modern engineering practices, identifying opportunities to improve platform capability.
Evaluate and introduce tools, frameworks and practices that enhance productivity, reliability and scalability.
Lead initiatives to improve developer experience, release processes, testing strategies and operational maturity.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, feedback loops, metrics and engineering best practice.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

Significant experience in software engineering, platform engineering or data engineering roles, with demonstrable time spent in a senior or lead capacity.
Strong hands-on experience designing and delivering solutions onAWS.
Strong experience working withDatabricksor similar Data lakehouse technologies in enterprise data or platform environments.
Proven experience building and supporting scalable data pipelines, distributed processing workloads, and cloud-native platforms.
Experience leading engineers and driving technical delivery across cross-functional teams.
Experience with platform automation, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
Experience operating within governed enterprise environments, with an understanding of security, risk and compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

Strong knowledge ofAWSservices, particularly in storage, compute, orchestration, monitoring and security.
Strong experience withDatabricks or similar Data lakehouse technologies, including notebooks, workflows, cluster management and data processing patterns.
Strong programming capability inPythonandSQL.
Good understanding ofSparkand distributed data processing concepts.
Experience with data architecture, data modelling and modern lakehouse principles.
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and automation tooling such asTerraform,CloudFormationor similar.
Experience with DevOps and engineering tooling such asGit, CI/CD platforms, containerisation, and workflow orchestration tools.
Understanding of observability practices including logging, metrics, monitoring and alerting.

Skills & Competencies

Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical ability, with a pragmatic approach to delivery.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to influence engineering direction and drive adoption of standards and best practices.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities and evolving requirements.

Preferred

Experience in financial services, insurance, pensions or other regulated environments.
Experience supporting shared platforms used by multiple product or domain teams.
Exposure to data governance, metadata, lineage and access control frameworks.
AWS certifications such asAWS Certified Solutions Architect,AWS Certified Data Engineer, or similar.
Databricks certification is an advantage.

What Success Looks Like

The Vulcan platform is reliable, scalable and secure, with clear engineering standards and strong operational performance.
Engineers are supported and mentored effectively, with improved delivery quality and team capability.
Platform users are able to build and run data products more efficiently through reusable, well-governed capabilities.
AWS and Databricks services are used effectively to balance scalability, maintainability and cost.
Continuous improvement is embedded into the team’s culture and engineering practices.

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données robustes sur AWS, en utilisant S3, Lambda, Glue, Redshift, EMR et Step Functions.

Optimiser les performances et la scalabilité des systèmes de traitement de données dans le cloud.

Automatiser la gestion et le déploiement des infrastructures de données via Terraform, Git et CI/CD.

Participer à l'intégration de solutions IA Générative / RAG (Amazon Bedrock, OpenSearch, embeddings, vector search).

About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Home page

Customer Stories

Our Values

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech
— du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first
? Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ?

Chez Agicap
, la Data Platform
répond aux besoins analytics (reporting, IA) et de synchronisation de données au service de toute l'entreprise. Elle s'appuie sur Google Cloud Platform
(notamment BigQuery et Composer), Airbyte
, dbt
et Looker
pour maintenir et diffuser des données à jour, consolidées et fiables.

🔥 Le chantier qui change tout
: l'ouverture de l'accès à la donnée d'entreprise par l'IA via notre serveur MCP Analytics
. On a déjà posé les premières briques avec les Explores Looker gouvernés par les DA — la suite logique, c'est l'extension à BigQuery couplée à une couche sémantique
. Et c'est là que tu entres en jeu.

👥L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers
qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts
et Pauline (Head of Data)
. Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering)
et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations
.

L'équipe en 3 mots
: soudée, pragmatique, exigeante techniquement. On porte beaucoup de sujets stratégiques en parallèle — c'est pour ça qu'on cherche un·e senior qui pourra prendre vite ses marques et apporter du poids sur les décisions d'architecture.

💪 Tes missions

Tu alternes entre run exigeant
et chantiers structurants
:

Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform. Une part de ton temps va au run (gestion des incidents, support DA), réparti au sein de l'équipe DE. Tu conçois et enrichis tests, monitoring et alerting — technique et fonctionnel
Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery
Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run)
Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditionne la qualité des réponses de l'IA. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses
Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA

👀 Comment on travaille

Daily DE + weekly Data pour partager les avancées et débloquer vite
Décisions d'architecture co-construites et documentées, code review systématique, amélioration continue
Full remote pour les DE — l'équipe est distribuée, on sait travailler ensemble à distance
Une semaine par trimestre à Lyon avec toute l'équipe Data pour les sujets de fond et les moments humains
L'IA est un outil de travail quotidien : Claude Code, consignes par repo, marketplace interne de skills. La relecture humaine reste obligatoire — on utilise l'IA avec exigence
Contribution open source : on publie des connecteurs Airbyte

⭐ Notre stack

GCP : BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Composer, GKE, Looker
Ingestion : Airbyte self-hosted (CDC PostgreSQL et SQL Server), GCS Avro → tables externes BigQuery
Transformation & qualité : dbt, Elementary
IaC & CI/CD : Terraform, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions
Langages : Python, SQL, Docker
IA : Claude Code (skills et plugins internes), serveur MCP interne

🎯 Le profil qu'on cherche

Indispensable

5 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Engineering sur un Cloud Provider majeur, avec la responsabilité de maintenir des systèmes en production
SQL confirmé + modèles dbt complexes (matérialisation incrémentale, snapshots, macros) que tu sais debugger (doublons, données tardives, suppressions, changement de schéma) et optimiser (durée, coût)
Expérience solide en ingestion et orchestration de pipelines : debugging, dérive de schéma, reprise, backfill, analyse d'impacts
Python de qualité, testé et maîtrisé — maintenabilité et fiabilité au cœur de ta pratique
Infrastructure as Code et CI/CD au quotidien
Tu travailles avec un Coding Agent et tu sais prendre du recul pour vérifier ce qu'il produit
Tu es force de proposition, rigoureux·se, humble, et tu aimes transmettre : partager tes découvertes, expliquer tes choix aux équipes techniques comme métier, faire progresser tes collègues
Tu es à l'aise en équipe partiellement full-remote
Anglais B2 minimum

Un gros plus

Expérience sur une couche sémantique (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, LookML), sur le Knowledge Catalog GCP (ex-Dataplex) ou équivalent, ou plus largement sur la gouvernance de données : cataloging, lineage, classification, policy tags, ownership
Traitements en architecture événementielle et leurs spécificités (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, scaling, rejets, retries)

Un plus

Expérience GCP : BigQuery et son modèle de compute via réservations de slots, Composer, Cloud Run, GKE / Helm
Tu as construit des tools pour agents IA (serveur MCP, skills)
Intégrations dans des outils métier (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom)
Pipelines data en Change Data Capture
Contribution à l'écosystème Airbyte

🎁 Ce qu'on offre

Un rôle au cœur d'une AI-first scale-up fintech FT120, €145M levés, 8 000+ clients, 6 pays
Une Data Platform avec un vrai scope stratégique (reporting, IA, data gouvernance) et des sujets de fond pour les 2 prochaines année
Rémunération : 60K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC
CDI, forfait 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées
Full remote — venues à Lyon ponctuelles pour les moments d'équipe
25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée)
Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge)
Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib / EGYM wellpass, et plus

1er entretien technique avec Pauline (Head of Data) — discussion technique, challenge sur la manière d'aborder des problèmes, cadrage de sujets, use case Agicap — 1h

jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Data department builds and maintains both future-ready and traditional data platforms
, tools, and services to ensure easy, secure data access. It empowers data consumers with self-service capabilities while upholding governance and quality standards.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions
to meet business needs. Within this framework, the Tribe designs and implements structured, optimized data stores for APIs, reporting, and analytics. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. Their mission is to enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data consumption across the organization.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines
and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making
as part of our digital transformation.

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows
while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Functional Data Engineer, You Will

Build and maintain optimized data stores by designing, developing, and ensuring well-structured, high-performance data assets (e.g., databases) tailored for APIs, reporting, analytics, and BI tools.
Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering reliable, accurate, and accessible data for business intelligence, reporting, and analysis services while maintaining related infrastructure.
Collaborate with internal clients and teams as a trusted partner, understanding stakeholder needs, guiding them on data solutions, and working cross-functionally while adhering to Tribe methodologies and standards.
Ensure compliance and risk management by strictly following data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and banking security policies, mitigating risks in data collection, processing, and storage to safeguard client and institutional data.
Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, efficiency, and innovation—whether through new tools, automation, or process optimizations—while aligning with business and regulatory requirements.
Collect the data from the source and design it into models that will be used by developers. In this role you are the bridge between the business needs and the developers. You translate requests into models that will be interpreted by the developers.
Uphold data quality and governance by implementing validation rules, monitoring, and metadata management to maintain accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
Support stakeholders and troubleshoot issues by resolving data incidents (e.g., broken pipelines, latency problems) and partnering with analysts, product owners, or business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions—such as creating self-service datasets or optimizing queries for reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Education and experience:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
Equivalent experience: minimum 3 years.

Hard skills:
Working experience with databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL.
Knowledge of SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.
Profound Knowledge of data warehouse (DWH) modeling (e.g., Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault).
Understanding or knowledge of ETL tools like Informatica PowerCenter.
Understanding of Big Data technologies such as Spark, Astronomer.
Extended knowledge of PowerDesigner tool (or equivalent)

Soft skills:
Problem-solving mindset: ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and propose scalable solutions.
Collaboration: strong team player with experience in cross-functional Agile teams.
Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for data quality, delivery timelines, and system reliability.
Communication: ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Continuous learning: stays updated on emerging data technologies.

Languages:
You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.

SUSTAINABILITY AND IMPACT

We strongly believe in the positive impact that the financial sector can have on the world. BNP Paribas Fortis offers sustainable and responsible investment products and solutions and encourages social entrepreneurship. Together with our customers, we are working towards a better future every day.

DEVELOPMENT & CAREER PERSPECTIVES

GOOD PLACE TO WORK

You can become a member of internal networks made up of people who are united around common causes, commitments or passions.

OUR ENGAGEMENT

At BNP Paribas Fortis, we want to attract and retain all talent, whatever their gender, age, background or sexual orientation, and irrespective of whether they are living with a disability, as every person has their own experiences and their own identity. All of our full-time vacancies are also open to candidates wishing to work on an 80% or 90% full-time equivalent basis.

TEMPTED BY THE CHALLENGE?

We take a holistic approach to our customers’ challenges and help them build sustainable, production-ready data solutions that enable analytics, insights, and – where relevant – AI capabilities.

Your role in a nutshell

As a Data Engineer, you will design and build scalable data platforms and pipelines that power analytics and data products – and increasingly, Databricks-based Lakehouse solutions. Your work will include developing robust data architectures, implementing data pipelines, and building the foundations that other teams (analytics, data science, AI) can rely on.

You will be involved in all phases of projects: from understanding data requirements and architecture design to production deployment and continuous improvement.

In practice, your work will include:

- Designing and implementing scalable, production-grade data pipelines (batch and/or streaming) on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
- Building and maintaining modern cloud data platforms using technologies such as Databricks (or, depending on the customer, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, or AWS data services)
- Implementing data modeling approaches (e.g., Data Vault 2.0, dimensional modeling, or schema-on-read patterns)
- Ensuring data quality, governance, security, and performance optimization across the data platform
- Consulting and providing technical guidance to customers on data architecture and platform strategy
- Working as part of a team of experienced data engineers, architects, and data professionals

Solutions are built collaboratively, but in this role you will have the opportunity to take ownership and influence data architecture and solution design from the very beginning.

Your Databricks growth path at Solita

You are not required to know Databricks on day one. What matters most is solid data engineering experience and willingness to learn.

At Solita, you will have:

- A ‘structured learning path’ for Databricks (self-study material, internal trainings, certifications)
- Hands-on learning in projects together with experienced Databricks engineers
- Support from our ‘Databricks community’ and peers across countries
- Possibility to deepen into topics like Lakehouse architectures, Delta Lake, and Spark optimization over time

If you already have Databricks experience, that’s a strong plus – but it’s absolutely not a blocker if you don’t.

What helps you succeed in this role

Core data engineering experience

- Several years of hands-on experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and cloud data platforms

Cloud expertise

- Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure / AWS / GCP)
- Experience building data infrastructure using IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation)

Data technologies

- Hands-on experience with modern data platforms and tools such as Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Delta Lake, or cloud-native data services
- If you don’t yet have Databricks experience, you bring strong skills in similar technologies (e.g., Spark, data warehouses, cloud data services) and are motivated to learn Databricks with our support

Programming skills

- Proficiency in Python and SQL
- Experience with Scala, Java, or C# is beneficial

Data modeling & architecture

- Experience with data modeling techniques (e.g., dimensional modeling, Data Vault, wide tables, or similar)
- Understanding of data architecture principles and best practices

DevOps & ways of working

- Familiarity with CI/CD processes, Infrastructure-as-Code, and DevOps ways of working (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Git, automated testing)

Consultative approach

- Ability to listen, discuss, and translate business requirements into robust data solutions
- Comfortable working in a customer-facing, collaborative environment

Languages

- Fluent in French or Dutch, and English

Experience with AI/ML workloads (feature pipelines, model-serving data, MLOps) is a plus, but not required. Curiosity about how data platforms enable AI is more important than being an AI specialist yourself.

What we offer

- Challenging, meaningful and impactful projects with a wide variety of clients
- A diverse community of 400+ data and integration professionals who love to learn, challenge and support each other. You won’t be left alone.
- A relaxed, caring and trust-based culture where you can be yourself.
- A workplace with both freedom and responsibility. That’s what our employees see as one of the biggest benefits at Solita.
- Mentoring, coaching, and cross-unit learning opportunities to grow your expertise through Solita’s multidisciplinary collaboration, long-term client work, or domain specialization (e.g., Retail, Industrial, Health).
- A clear path to grow your **Databricks and cloud data platform** expertise, including access to trainings and certifications.

Read more about our projects and insights from our professionals:

- Solita launches AI agent orchestrator for enterprise software development: Solita RoadCrewAO™
- Solitans shaping AI – Rethinking the intersection of design and tech

Our offer

At Solita, we believe in rewarding our talent. You’ll enjoy a highly competitive salary complemented by a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and professional life.

Your benefits include:

- Flexible Mobility: Choose between a company car or a flexible mobility budget to suit your lifestyle.
- Daily Perks: Benefit from meal vouchers and a representation allowance.
- Comprehensive Health & Security: We provide robust group insurance and hospitalization insurance (Alan), offering peace of mind with access to online medical consultations whenever you need them.
- Well-being Support: Our dedicated Auntie well-being platform is there for you, offering support during challenging times.
- Modern Work Tools: Get set up for success with your choice of a Mac or Lenovo laptop and a mobile phone budget.
- Time Off: Enjoy 20 official holidays plus an additional 12 days (40 hours week), giving you well-deserved time to recharge.
- Flexible Work: We embrace modern work styles, offering homeworking possibilities in alignment with customer needs, allowing you to achieve a great work-life balance.

Shall we talk more?

Send us your CV or a link to your LinkedIn profile, and we will be in touch soon. We are looking forward to getting to know you. We’re eager to understand your passions, what truly drives you, and how Solita can support your aspirations both professionally and personally. We believe that when you thrive, we all thrive.

We don’t work with recruitment agencies for this position.

Bij Leftfields geloven we dat data en AI de drijvende kracht zijn achter de bedrijven van morgen. Wij helpen klanten met hun digitale transformatie door middel van slimme oplossingen op het gebied van data, AI en Python-development. Als jonge en dynamische organisatie groeien we snel. Om deze groei te structureren en onze data-afdeling vanaf de grond mee op te bouwen en te schalen, zoeken we een Senior Data Engineer die samen met ons de toekomst van Leftfields wil vormgeven.

Jouw RolAls Senior Data Engineer ben jij de technische ruggengraat van onze data-afdeling.Aan de ene kant zit je op uitdagende opdrachten bij de klant: je ontwerpt en bouwt moderne data-infrastructuren (Lakehouses, Cloud Data Platforms) en helpt in pre-sales trajecten om technische voorstellen scherp te stellen. jobs.description:
Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je meebouwen aan een datagedreven organisatie? Bij Quatra zoeken we een Junior Data Analyst die cijfers vertaalt naar heldere inzichten en mee inzet op automatisering en innovatieve (AI-)toepassingen.

Je maakt deel uit van een team van 9 collega’s en ondersteunt verschillende afdelingen met gerichte analyses en rapportering. Zo draag je actief bij aan de verdere optimalisatie van onze datawerking!

Als Junior Data Analyst bij Quatra ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

Je verzamelt, structureert en analyseert data uit verschillende bronnen.
Je vertaalt businessvragen naar concrete inzichten via rapporten en dashboards met behulp van diverse BI-tools.
Je bewaakt de datakwaliteit en detecteert afwijkingen.
Je optimaliseert en automatiseert rapportering en terugkerende analyses.
Je zorgt voor de integratie met operationele systemen zoals Odoo ERP, waarbij je de brug maakt tussen data en businessinzichten.
Je ontwikkelt data-oplossingen met SQL en Python(of een andere scripttaal), en werkt mee aan data pipelines en de verdere uitbouw van de data-architectuur.
Je verkent nieuwe databronnen en test AI-tools op hun meerwaarde voor Quatra.

Waarom kiezen voor Quatra?

Werken in een duurzaam en toekomstgericht bedrijf dat volop inzet op innovatie en groei.
Een leerrijke startersrol met groeikansen in data, BI en AI.
On-the-job coaching voor een vliegende start en voortdurende ondersteuning om te groeien in jouw rol.
Nauwe samenwerking tussen business en IT in een open en informele werksfeer.
Een marktconform salaris met extralegale voordelen, waaronder hospitalisatieverzekering en groepsverzekering.
Toegang tot Benefits at Work met aantrekkelijke personeelskortingen bij tal van bekende merken.
12 ADV-dagen bovenop je wettelijke vakantiedagen, zodat werk en privé mooi in balans blijven.
Toegang tot een Flex Income Plan, waarmee je jouw koopkracht verhoogt.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Je beschikt over een Bachelor- of Masterdiploma (of gelijkwaardig door ervaring) in een relevante richting.
Je hebt een eerste ervaring met data-analyse of bent een gemotiveerde starter.
Je hebt een analytische, oplossingsgerichte mindset en oog voor detail.
Je werkt gestructureerd en communiceert helder.
Je hebt interesse in AI, automatisering en nieuwe technologieën.
Je hebt basiskennis van SQL en minstens één programmeer- of scripttaal (bij voorkeur Python).
Je hebt al gewerkt met een BI-tool (via een stage, project of eerste job).
Kennis van ERP-systemen (zoals Odoo) en/of operationele bedrijfsprocessen (logistiek, productie, planning) is een troef.
Je begrijpt de impact van je werk op verschillende afdelingen en werkt graag samen in team.

! We kijken er naar uit jou binnen ons bedrijf en team te mogen verwelkomen.

Quatra is een internationale en snelgroeiende groep, gespecialiseerd in de inzameling en recyclage van gebruikte frituurolie. jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As Productivity Management Super User, you drive and optimize productivity across all Contract Logistics sites in Belgium. You are the expert for productivity tools such as PMX, Activity Tracker, and Effitrack, ensuring correct implementation, data reliability, and continuous improvement. You act as the link between Operations, IS/IT, and BI, translating operational needs into system solutions and supporting the integration of productivity management into daily operations through close collaboration with all stakeholder levels.

‎

How you create impact

Implement and roll out PMX and related productivity tools across new customers and sites in Belgium, ensuring standardized and scalable setups
Act as functional owner for PMX, Activity Tracker (incl. Live Dashboard), and Effitrack; configure users, targets, processes, roles, and workflows
Define, implement, and adapt productivity processes, drivers, and improvements based on evolving business needs
Translate new business and workforce management requirements into practical system solutions
Provide 1st and 2nd line support, troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, and validate new releases and functionalities
Train and support key users and site teams, ensuring knowledge transfer and operational self-sufficiency
Act as the main liaison between Operations, IS, and BI, ensuring accurate data, reporting, and dashboards
Analyze productivity data to drive fact-based decisions, embed productivity management across the organization, and foster a continuous improvement culture

What we would like you to bring

Bachelor or Master degree, with experience in warehouse/logistics environments (3PL preferred).
Experience with productivity tools, WMS, and operational systems, including system integrations.
Strong understanding of PMX, Activity Tracker, and logistics operational processes.
Proven ability in data analysis, deviation detection, and translating insights into solutions.
Hands-on experience with Excel and BI/reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, Business Objects).
Capable of testing, validating, and coordinating system changes, releases, and local implementations.
Strong analytical, structured, and proactive mindset with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in Dutch and English, customer-focused, willing to travel within Belgium, and able to bridge business and IT.

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel, you have the freedom to be yourself and the opportunity to grow. We support your personal and professional development through a wide range of learning opportunities, backed by the strength of a global market leader. Contribute your ideas, help us get better every day, and experience a workplace where your opinion truly matters.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

jobs.description:
Pierre Fabre is accelerating its transformation toward a more digital, data-driven and AI-enabled R&D organization.

To support this ambition, we are creating a new Data Engineering Lead
position in Toulouse (Langlade, 31).

You will be part of the R&D Data Engineering team that operates the data platform and delivers trusted, reusable data products for Data Science, Biometry and all other R&D functions. The role combines team leadership, technical ownership and hands-on delivery. It is accountable for turning fragmented scientific and operational data into governed, production-grade assets that accelerate R&D decisions and use cases.

Your role within a pioneering company in full expansion:

1. Lead the Data Engineering team

· Build, organize and lead an internal team of data engineers, complemented by external partners when required.
· Set clear priorities, allocate capacity and establish an explicit delivery backlog jointly with R&D stakeholders and Data Science leads.
· Coach engineers, raise engineering standards, develop skills and create a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

2. Own data-platform engineering and operations

· Take technical ownership of the R&D data platform in its AWS landing-zone environment, from implementation through reliable day-to-day operation and evolution.
· Define and enforce reference architectures, reusable patterns and engineering standards for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage and data serving.
· Implement infrastructure as code, CI/CD, automated testing, environment separation, observability, incident response and disaster-recovery practices.

3. Deliver trusted data products for R&D

· Partner with scientists, Data Science, Biometry, Business Analysts and R&D domain teams to translate needs into prioritised data products and services.
· Design, build and operate batch, incremental, API-based and event-driven pipelines across laboratory, preclinical, clinical, external-partner and operational sources.
· Create curated, documented and reusable datasets with clear schemas, ownership, quality rules, access conditions, SLAs and lifecycle management.
· Provide governed access through SQL, APIs, notebooks and other fit-for-purpose interfaces, enabling analytics, AI and scientific applications.

4. Embed quality, security and compliance by design

· Embed automated data-quality controls, lineage, metadata capture, auditability and reproducibility into engineering workflows.
· Apply role-based and data-level access controls, encryption, retention and classification requirements in partnership with Security, Data Governance, Quality, Legal and the DPO.
· Support GxP-qualified workloads, GDPR obligations and HDS-compliant EU data residency where required.

5. Shape the engineering roadmap and ecosystem

· Contribute to platform technology selection and lead the engineering roadmap from MVP to scale.
· Evaluate and integrate relevant technologies across AWS and modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or SageMaker Unified Studio, based on the selected target architecture.
· Ensure interoperability with the existing R&D estate, including Azure-hosted sources, GitHub, Veeva, electronic laboratory notebooks, statistical computing environments and external CRO/partner channels.

This position is compatible with teleworking up to 2 days a week according to company rules.
We offer an attractive remuneration/benefits package: Incentives, profit-sharing, Pierre Fabre shareholding with matching contribution, health and provident insurance, 16 days of holidays (RTT) in addition to 25 days of personal holidays, public transport participation...

Your skills at the service of innovative projects:

Essential

· Significant experience in data engineering, including ownership of production-grade cloud data platforms and large-scale data pipelines.
· Demonstrated experience leading and developing data engineers
· Strong experience with AWS and at least one modern data platform or lakehouse/warehouse ecosystem such as Databricks, Snowflake or SageMaker Unified Studio.
· Advanced practical skills in SQL and Python, data modelling, ETL/ELT, orchestration, APIs and distributed data processing.
· Experience with cloud object storage, open table/file formats, metadata, data quality, lineage and secure data access.
· Experience implementing engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, monitoring and incident management.
· Ability to engage with scientific and business stakeholders, convert ambiguous needs into executable delivery plans and communicate technical trade-offs clearly.
· Professional fluency in English; French is strongly valued.

Preferred

· Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare or another regulated R&D environment.
· Understanding of scientific and clinical data, including ELN/LIMS, instrument data, omics, preclinical, clinical or real-world data.
· Experience supporting GxP workloads, GDPR, HDS or comparable regulated-data requirements.
· Knowledge of FAIR principles, data products, semantic layers, master/reference data and federated data governance.
· Experience operating across AWS and Azure boundaries and integrating SaaS platforms, partner data exchanges and streaming services.
· Master’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, data or a related discipline.

jobs.description:
Rejoins Vertuoza, une scale-up SaaS belge en pleine expansion, et deviens Senior Data & ML Engineer chez Vertuoza. 🧬

Chez Vertuoza, on construit bien plus qu’un logiciel. On aide les entrepreneurs du bâtiment à travailler plus sereinement, à mieux piloter leur business et à réussir. Et pour continuer à accélérer, on cherche Senior Data & ML Engineer

🧑🏻‍💻 Le contexte

Vertuoza dispose de beaucoup de données issues de milliers d'entreprises du bâtiment (devis, prestations, matériaux, prix, chantiers, localisations). L'objectif est de s'en servir pour créer des fonctionnalités prédictives. Le poste consiste à construire de zéro la fondation data et ML.

Les missions :

Fondation data : construire des pipelines fiables, reproductibles et observables (collecte, nettoyage, normalisation de données hétérogènes, choix de la granularité, datasets prêts pour le ML).
Normalisation métier : faire comprendre que « Chaudière Vaillant gaz 8.5 kW » et « Installation chauffage gaz 8500 W » désignent presque la même chose. Cela passe par la classification, l'extraction de caractéristiques, le regroupement de données similaires et la construction d'une taxonomie, en combinant règles, statistiques, embeddings, LLMs et ML classique.
Prix et tendances (1er cas d'usage) : suivre l'évolution des prix par prestation et par région, établir des prix de référence et recommander des fourchettes. Tout l'enjeu est de trouver le bon équilibre entre précision et granularité.
Rayon d'action géographique (2e cas d'usage) : prédire jusqu'où une entreprise peut raisonnablement travailler, à partir de son métier, de sa localisation, des distances, des montants et de ses taux de conversion.
ML en production : du feature engineering jusqu'au déploiement, avec monitoring, gestion de la dérive et amélioration continue. Le travail ne s'arrête pas aux notebooks.
Collaboration avec les équipes AI, Product et Engineering pour trancher des questions concrètes : quelles données sont fiables, quel volume minimum faut-il, quel niveau de confiance accorder, et quand choisir le ML, un LLM ou une simple règle.

💙 Pourquoi Vertuoza ?

Une scale-up en forte croissance avec de vraies ambitions internationales
Un produit concret utilisé par +7.000 clients
Un environnement où tu peux avoir de l’impact rapidement
Une proximité directe avec les fondateurs
Une culture à 3 axes : growth, people & customer centric

💰 Package

Grille salariale claire en fonction du niveau de séniorité
Bonus trimestriels liés à la performance collective
Voiture de société électrique (BMW ou Mini) 🚗
Assurance santé complète (Alan)
Rémunération flexible et optimisée via Payflip
Des moments d’équipe réguliers pour créer de vraies connexions entre Vertuozes 🤝

📝 Les étapes de recrutement

Rencontre [online] avec Manon, Talent Acquisition Specialist – 45 min / 1h
Test technique + test personnalité/motivation/logique [at home]
General Interview [on-site] avec Maurizio (CTO) & Pierre Head of IA – 1h
Technical Interview [on-site] avec Pierre Head of IA - 1h
Final interview [online] avec Manon pour discuter de l’offre et du package – 1h

✨ Profil recherché

Indispensable : expérience senior en Data et/ou ML Engineering, très bon niveau en Python et SQL, pipelines et modèles déjà mis en production, habitude des données réelles et imparfaites, maîtrise des fondamentaux du ML, connaissance de la data quality et de l'observabilité, à l'aise avec le cloud (GCP est un plus).
Atouts : NLP, embeddings et semantic matching, LLMs pour structurer des données, entity resolution, séries temporelles, géospatial, clustering et taxonomies, pricing.
Soft skills : intérêt pour la réalité métier, pragmatisme, autonomie, capacité à prendre en charge des problèmes peu structurés et à communiquer aussi bien avec la tech qu'avec le produit, aisance dans un environnement de scale-up.

Pourquoi rejoindre Vertuoza :
les données sont réelles et les modèles ont un impact direct sur la façon dont des milliers d'entreprises du bâtiment font leurs devis. Il y a beaucoup à construire, sur des problèmes encore largement ouverts dans ce secteur.

CDI | Environnement international

Nous accompagnons un groupe international reconnu dans le recrutement d’un Engineering Team Lead
(Data) pour renforcer son équipe Data & Analytics.
Le contexte est intéressant : la Data Platform existe déjà, elle est utilisée à grande échelle et doit maintenant passer un nouveau cap en matière de robustesse, standardisation, performance et maîtrise des coûts
.
Nous cherchons donc moins un manager « classique » qu’un référent technique senior
, capable de prendre de la hauteur sur l’architecture tout en restant proche du code et des équipes.

Votre rôle

Vous devenez l’un des principaux référents techniques de la Data Platform.
Votre responsabilité sera notamment de :
Faire évoluer l’architecture et les modèles de données autour de Snowflake, dbt, Airflow et Azure
.
Définir et faire vivre les standards d’engineering : qualité du code, tests, CI/CD, observabilité, documentation et data contracts.
Garantir la fiabilité et la scalabilité
de la plateforme.
Piloter les sujets de performance et de FinOps
, notamment autour des consommations Snowflake et Azure.
Construire des fondations Data suffisamment robustes et documentées pour favoriser le self-service.
Accompagner techniquement les Data Engineers et Analytics Engineers et faire progresser les pratiques de l’équipe.
Participer directement aux décisions d’architecture et aux sujets techniques les plus structurants.

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement international et transverse, en interaction avec les équipes Data, AI/ML, Architecture, IT, Product et les différentes équipes métiers.

Le poste comprend du management direct de profils Data Engineering & Analytics Engineering.

Le profil recherché

Nous cherchons avant tout quelqu’un qui a déjà eu un vrai rôle de leadership technique sur une plateforme Data
, au-delà de la seule construction de pipelines.

Idéalement, vous avez :
Environ 8 à 10 ans d’expérience
en Data Engineering / Analytics Engineering.
Une excellente maîtrise de Snowflake, dbt, Airflow et Azure
.
Un très bon niveau en SQL
et de solides réflexes de Software Engineering.
Une expérience concrète des sujets de data quality, testing, CI/CD, observabilité et data contracts
.
Une sensibilité aux problématiques de coûts et de performance Cloud / Data Platform
.
L’habitude d’évoluer dans des environnements complexes, internationaux et multi-sources.
Une capacité à définir des standards techniques, mais surtout à embarquer les équipes pour qu’ils soient réellement adoptés.
Un anglais courant
, indispensable dans le cadre du poste.

Pourquoi ce rôle est intéressant

C’est un poste avec une forte autonomie technique
et un impact direct sur la manière dont la plateforme Data va évoluer.

DATA ENGINEER (FABRIC/AI)
Ieper - Hybride - Greenfield

BEDRIJF:

Deze internationale productiegroep ontwikkelt en produceert elektronica en bekabeling op maat van klanten in sectoren waar kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid cruciaal zijn, waaronder ruimtevaart, defensie, mobiliteit, healthcare en industrie. De organisatie heeft productiesites in Europa, Noord-Amerika en Azië.
Data krijgt vandaag een steeds belangrijkere rol binnen die omgeving. Het bestaande platform draait op Azure, maar de volgende stap moet nog gebouwd worden: een nieuwe dataomgeving op Microsoft Fabric. En net daar kom jij binnen.

JOBOMSCHRIJVING:

Als Data Engineer combineer je een bestaand platform met een greenfield uitdaging. Samen met een collega Data Engineer neem je het huidige Azure-platform voor je rekening: je bouwt en optimaliseert pipelines in Azure Data Factory, schrijft SQL, werkt aan datamodellen en bouwt mee aan de semantische laag achter Power BI. Je focus ligt op de backend, de visualisaties nemen andere collega's op. Tegelijk start de migratie naar Microsoft Fabric. Je trekt die mee, maakt technische keuzes en bepaalt mee hoe het toekomstige dataplatform eruitziet.
Je werkt in een klein team en rechtstreeks met mensen uit de business. De beslissingslijnen zijn kort: zie je dat iets beter kan, dan krijg je de ruimte om het aan te pakken. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid op en ziet je eigen keuzes terug in het platform van morgen.

JOUW PROFIEL:

Je hebt 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer.
Je hebt sterke ervaring met Azure Data Factory.
Je hebt ervaring met Microsoft Fabric of je wil je er snel in verdiepen.
Je hebt ervaring met datamodellering.
Je kent de backend van Power BI en hebt basiskennis van DAX.
Je hebt ervaring met Python, PySpark is mooi meegenomen.
Je gaat makkelijk in gesprek met de business.
Je spreekt vlot Engels en Nederlands.

UNIEK KARAKTER:

Je stapt in vóór het nieuwe dataplatform gebouwd is. Een Microsoft Fabric-omgeving vanaf nul mee vormgeven en de migratie zelf trekken: een ervaring die veel Data Engineers pas veel later in hun loopbaan krijgen.

En daar stopt het niet. Zodra het datafundament staat, wil de organisatie nadrukkelijk richting AI. Die use-cases staan nog in de beginfase, dus je denkt nu al mee over wat mogelijk is en hoe het platform daarop voorbereid wordt. Eerst Fabric bouwen, daarna mee bepalen wat AI er bovenop kan betekenen.

jobs.description:
Join the EPEX SPOT Team: Innovate, Collaborate, Thrive

Job Summary:

As a Lead Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and evolving EPEX SPOT's cloud-native Data Platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will combine hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership, helping deliver trusted, scalable, and AI-ready data products that support business operations, analytics, and innovation initiatives.
Acting as a technical leader within the Data Platform team, you will coach and mentor Data Engineers, drive engineering excellence, and contribute to the adoption of modern data platform capabilities such as BigQuery, Dataform, Dataplex, Dataflow, BigLake, and Vertex AI.
Working in a highly collaborative Agile environment, you will partner closely with Product Owners, Architects, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Security teams, and other platform teams to deliver business value while ensuring platform reliability, governance, and scalability.
Your scope will include:
Enterprise Data Platform development and operations
Data ingestion, processing, and analytics enablement
Data Governance and Data Product implementation
AI and Machine Learning enablement
Coaching and technical leadership within the Data Engineering team
Cross-team collaboration and alignment in an Agile environment

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead Data Engineering Delivery

Drive the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of enterprise-scale data solutions by:
Designing and implementing scalable data pipelines and data products
Building robust batch and streaming data processing solutions
Ensuring platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency
Supporting architecture decisions and technical roadmap execution
Acting as the technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges

2. Coach and Develop Data Engineers

Promote engineering excellence across the Data Platform team by:

Coaching and mentoring Data Engineers in technical and professional growth
Conducting code reviews and design reviews
Encouraging knowledge sharing and continuous learning
Supporting onboarding and development of new team members
Driving adoption of engineering standards and best practices

3.
Enable Data Governance and Self-Service Data Products

Support the delivery of trusted and governed data assets by:
Implementing governance capabilities using Google Dataplex
Supporting metadata management, lineage, cataloguing, and data quality initiatives
Ensuring compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements
Enabling self-service analytics through reusable and governed data products

4. Foster Agile Collaboration and Platform Alignment

Collaborate effectively within Agile product teams and across the technology landscape:
Promoting DevOps and DataOps practices
Supporting a culture of transparency, ownership, and continuous improvement

5. Contribute to EPEX SPOT's AI and Data innovation ambitions by:

Building data foundations for analytics and AI use cases
Supporting the integration of Vertex AI and related AI services
Collaborating with Data Scientists to operationalize Machine Learning solutions

Key Requirements

Hard Skills

Google Cloud Data Platform Expertise

Strong hands-on experience with:
BigQuery
Dataform
Dataplex (catalog, lineage, data quality, tag application)
Data lake and Lakehouse implementation on GCP: Cloud Storage, external tables, BigLake, and the trade-offs between external and materialized data
Cloud Composer /Cloud Workflows
Cloud Run /Functions
IAM and Security Services
Cloud Monitoring and observability
Dataflow

Data Engineering

ELT/ETL architecture and implementation
API-based data integration
Data Contract implementation in the pipeline (assertions, quality checks, validation at build time)
Real-time and streaming architecture
Metadata management and data lineage
Data quality management
Event-driven architectures

Engineering Practices

AI-assisted engineering: proficient with GCP AI assistance (Gemini in BigQuery, Gemini Code Assist) and able to coach the data engineers on using it productively and safely
Python
SQL
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)
CI/CD pipelines
Git and version control
DevOps and DataOps practices
Platform monitoring and observability
Performance optimization and cost management

Agile Delivery

Proven experience working in Agile environments

Soft Skills

Strong technical leader who drives results through expertise, influence, and a passion for developing engineering talent.
Excellent communicator and collaborator, able to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in international environments.
Combines a proactive, analytical, and continuous improvement mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a commitment to delivering high-quality business value.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 7 years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Proven experience building and operating cloud-native data platforms.
Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform data services.
Demonstrated experience coaching and mentoring Data Engineers.
Experience implementing data governance and data quality frameworks.
Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating across multiple product and platform teams.
Preferred certifications:

-Google Professional Data Engineer
-Google Professional Cloud Architect
-Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
-Terraform Associate

Location:

Your work location will preferably be Paris, with no specific restriction amongst other EPEX office locations and an attractive hybrid work policy.

Who Are We?

The European Power Exchange EPEX SPOT SE operates physical short-term electricity markets in Central Western Europe, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, the Nordics and in Poland. Furthermore, EPEX SPOT newly offers local flexibility markets solution and Guarantees of Origin auctions, to foster the integration of renewable energy sources and to enhance the engagement of consumers and producers in the power market. The heart of our business is to bring together electricity supply and demand across Europe. We shape the future of the European power market by supporting decarbonization, decentralization, digitalization and contributing to the global energy transition toward a sustainable future.
At EPEX SPOT, we believe in fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where every team member can thrive. Our core values— trustful teams, innovation & agility, and customer centricity— are the foundation of everything we do. Diversity is the cornerstone of our way of working, reflected in how we face challenges and work together as unique individuals to build a stronger organization.
Our DNA is embedded in continuous improvement via constructive feedback, collaboration among colleagues and transparency culture. We believe in true leadership, supporting our vision towards the energy transition, as well as the development of our People.

Why join EPEX SPOT?

At EPEX SPOT, you'll be part of a passionate, talented, and international team dedicated to shaping the future of the European power market. Our offices and inclusive workplaces throughout Europe celebrate diversity and support our employees to unfold their full potential.
We offer a decentralized working system with an appealing Home Office and Hybrid Working setup, serving individuals’ self-determination of working conditions. Our goal-oriented, trustworthy, and flexible approach, given our multicultural environment, allows our employees’ to find a suited work-life balance. We strive for leadership development and provide the right support through an active and modern remote and hybrid teamwork.
We provide numerous career opportunities within the company and within EEX Group, granting a platform for continuous growth that puts you in the driver’s seat of your career.
We are proud of our commitment to gender equality, demonstrated by our strong performance in the gender-equality-index-at-epex-spot. Our HR strategy focuses on our People and Organization, enhancing both motivation and employability, while equally developing individuals’ skills.
Join us at EPEX SPOT and become part of a forward-thinking company where your contributions will make a significant impact, for the energy transition as well as for your career!
Discover more about us and explore career opportunities at https://www.epexspot.com/en

Benefits of working with Us:

Hybrid Working Conditions:
We offer you the flexibility of working from home or other locations for the best possible work-life balance.
Training Opportunities:
We invest in your continuous development with a dedicated annual training budget to enhance your skills through various upskilling programs and initiatives.
Career Path:
We support your career aspirations with clear pathways for advancement within the company and the EEX Group.
Internal Mobility:
We offer and support the possibility to explore new roles within the company to expand your skills and experience.
Leadership Journey:
We promote a culture of recognition and reward with the EPEX SPOT leadership journey that encourages everyone’s progression and development.
